examples.name: Sample — a single-storey plan
paragraphs: Twelve labelled areas, eight of them with a printed size, and dimension lines on all four sides. The printed dimensions do not add up (32'-0", 40'-0" and 44'-0" under a 62'-0" span) and are copied as printed.

snippets.text: ```diagram Floor plan of a single-storey house. MASTER BEDROOM 15'6" x 14'0" DINING 11'0" x 11'6" DECK KITCHEN 10'0" x 13'6" GREAT ROOM 16'0" x 20'0" BEDROOM #3 11'0" x 11'6" MASTER BATH GARAGE 22'0" x 22'0" STUDY 11'0" x 9'6" FOYER BEDROOM #2 14'0" x 13'6" PORCH Dimension lines: 62'-0" across the top, divided 32'-0", 40'-0", 44'-0"; 28'-0", 22'-0", 15'-0" along the bottom; 54'-0" down the left, divided 30'-0", 24'-0"; 30'-0" and 24'-0" on the right. ## Related - [Geographic Maps](12-images-and-diagrams-2-diagrams-geographic-maps.html)§12.2.4 — the same trap of a spatial figure coerced into a table - [Electrical Schematics](12-images-and-diagrams-2-diagrams-electrical-schematics.html)§12.2.3 — a spatial figure coerced into a graph - [Images](12-images-and-diagrams-1-images-images.html)§12.1.1 — the general rule for what an image becomes Skill text for this ruleGenerator skill- Never render a floor plan or architectural drawing as a table. - Describe it in a fenced block tagged diagram, in this shape: one line saying what the drawing is; then a list with one item per labelled area in reading order (top to bottom, left to right), the label then its printed size, both exactly as printed (an area with no size is listed by its label); then every dimension line, scale bar, legend entry and note, verbatim. - Do not state adjacency, computed areas or corrected dimensions; copy printed dimensions even if they do not add up.Checker skill- FAIL (MUST) if a floor plan or architectural drawing is rendered as an HTML table. - FAIL (MUST) if a room label, printed size, dimension, scale bar or legend entry printed on the drawing is missing or altered. - FAIL (MUST) if the description states an adjacency, a computed value or a corrected dimension that the drawing does not print. - WARN (SHOULD) if the description does not follow the fixed shape (what it is, then the areas in reading order, then dimensions and notes).
